title: U.S. strikes 3 Iranian oil tankers after Navy ships targeted with ballistic missiles
summary: The U.S. military struck three Iranian oil tankers — permanently disabling two (M/T Downy, M/T Stark 1) and destroying one (M/T Kylo) — after Iran's IRGC fired ballistic missiles at U.S. Navy warships near the Strait of Hormuz. Iran retaliated by attacking U.S.-linked tankers and threatened a 'restricted maritime zone', effectively keeping the world's most critical oil chokepoint under siege.
why: 重大地缘升级：霍尔木兹封锁延续推高油价，带动市场避险情绪与通胀预期同步上升，对期权隐含波动率及美联储加息路径均有直接影响；能源股受益，科技股承压；该冲突本轮自9月5日以来持续演变中。

title: Brent crude surges near $97/barrel as U.S.-Iran fighting keeps Hormuz risk elevated
summary: Brent crude gained as much as 0.8% to near $97 a barrel at Monday's open, with WTI around $92, extending a weekly gain of 7.8% (WTI nearly +10%). Iran threatened a 'restricted maritime zone' beyond the Strait of Hormuz, threatening further supply disruptions.
why: 油价创五周新高直接加大美联储9月加息概率，能源通胀压力重燃；组合中石油相关敞口（及能源股期权）需关注；布油近$97意味着年内涨幅超50%，供应风险溢价持续重定价。

title: Asia-Pacific markets open broadly higher Monday; Kospi leads with +3.09% on Iran risk repricing
summary: Asia-Pacific equities opened broadly higher on Monday as investors repriced risk around U.S.-Iran escalation: Kospi +3.09%, Nikkei 225 +1%, Topix +0.55%, S&P/ASX 200 flat. Mainland China's CSI 300 rose 0.44%, while Hong Kong's Hang Seng Index dipped 0.15%, reflecting divergent risk appetites between onshore and offshore China markets.
why: 港股与A股表现分化值得关注：南向资金净流入动力对冲外资情绪压力，但恒指小幅承压说明港股对全球流动性收紧（美联储加息预期）较敏感，持仓中的卖put策略需关注行权价附近支撑位。

title: August jobs report: U.S. adds 162,000 jobs, crushing 53,000 estimate; Fed September hike back on table
summary: U.S. nonfarm payrolls rose 162,000 in August — the strongest monthly gain since March — far above the 53,000 consensus estimate. Unemployment held at 4.1%. Wage growth: +0.3% MoM, +3.1% YoY. Previous two months revised up a combined +55K. Traders immediately raised bets on a Federal Reserve rate hike at the September FOMC meeting.
why: 强劲NFP叠加油价高企，美联储9月加息概率急升，短端利率上行；对组合sell put策略影响：波动率曲面可能陡化，需警惕短期波动率骤升；同时对高估值科技股（谷歌、Palantir、英伟达等）估值形成压力。

title: Tencent (00700) repurchases 925,000 shares for HK$551M on Sept. 4; buyback streak continues
summary: Per HKEX filing disclosed via Futunn, Tencent bought back 925,000 ordinary shares on September 4 at prices ranging from HK$591 to HK$605 per share, totaling approximately HK$551 million. Cumulative repurchases since the 2026 authorization resolution: 53.018 million shares (0.577% of total issued).
why: 延续报道：腾讯持续每日回购，规模维持5~6亿港元/日，年内累计回购已近300亿港元，强力支撑EPS及价值底；对持有腾讯covered call策略者有利，支撑股价下行空间有限；HKEX官方披露，数字可信。

title: Tesla's Cybercab opens to public in Austin; NHTSA launches probe into safety certification
summary: Tesla opened its driverless Cybercab robotaxi to the public in Austin, Texas, on Sept. 4, deploying a 45-vehicle fleet within a geofenced area. The two-seat vehicle has no steering wheel, pedals or mirrors — features normally required by federal safety rules. NHTSA immediately opened an Audit Query on ~1,000 Cybercabs over Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standards certification. The Robotaxi app hit #1 on the App Store Travel chart within hours.
why: Robotaxi正式商业落地标志特斯拉从EV制造商向自动驾驶运营商转型的关键节点；NHTSA介入是最大不确定性——若监管要求召回或暂停运营，Robotaxi估值逻辑将大幅受损；短期高波动，对TSLA持仓策略需关注长腿期权定价。

title: Xiaomi Auto debuts at IFA Berlin, signs 8 German dealer groups; SU7 & YU7 set for European launch in 2027
summary: At IFA Berlin 2026 (Sept. 4–8), Xiaomi Auto signed letters of intent with eight major German dealer groups — including Emil Frey (Europe's largest car dealer group) and LUEG Mobility (Germany's first authorized Mercedes-Benz dealer). Xiaomi will bring SU7 and YU7 EVs to Europe in 2027, anchored by its 'Human × Car × Home' ecosystem. Europe is only the starting point; similar partnerships in other markets will follow.
why: 延续报道：小米IFA柏林亮相（9月4-8日），欧洲扩张是SU7/YU7交付量和ASP逻辑的重大验证——8家德国经销商网络意味着2027年正式销售基础设施就位，有望重估小米汽车海外溢价；叠加累计交付超70万辆里程碑，关注小米三季报交付数据。
